canonical_solution.motive: Revenge for thesis rejection and anger at university corruption
canonical_solution.method: Deployed ransomware using code from rejected thesis
key_connections: IP address 103.XX.XXX.XX matches between server logs and laptop
Thesis code identical to ransomware code
Former USG Treasurer with system access knowledge

critical.name: Server Image with Hash
critical.why_critical: Without hash verification, entire case is inadmissible
critical.common_violation: Direct file copying without forensic imaging

critical.name: Suspect's Laptop Commands
critical.why_critical: Direct link between suspect and server intrusion
critical.key_data: Same IP address as server logs

required: WDCD - Warrant to Disclose Computer Data
WSSECD - Warrant to Search, Seize & Examine Computer Data

prosecution_requirements: Link suspect to the crime through digital evidence

motive_understanding.check: Did player mention thesis rejection or corruption revenge?

evidence_correlation.check: Did player connect IP addresses and code similarity?

method_explanation.check: Did player explain how the attack was executed?

missing_evidence.critical_missing: CRITICAL ERROR: Missing {evidence_name}. This is required to prove {legal_element}. Without it, prosecution under RA 10175 will fail.
missing_evidence.supporting_missing: Missing {evidence_name} weakens the case but not fatal. Consider obtaining to strengthen {aspect}.

procedural_violations.no_hash: FATAL: No hash verification on server image. Defense will argue evidence tampering. Case likely inadmissible.
procedural_violations.no_write_blocker: Serious violation: Direct file copying detected. Original evidence potentially modified. Admissibility questionable.
procedural_violations.chain_broken: Chain of custody incomplete. Defense can create reasonable doubt about evidence integrity.
procedural_violations.no_warrant: Evidence obtained without proper WDCD/WSSECD. Will be suppressed as fruit of illegal search.

legal_issues.weak_correlation: IP address correlation alone is circumstantial. Need stronger link like thesis code match.
legal_issues.no_extortion_proof: Without ransom note, cannot prove extortion element of RA 10175.
legal_issues.timeline_gaps: Inconsistent timeline between server logs and metadata. Defense will exploit this.

strength_assessment.strong: Solid case. Hash-verified evidence, complete chain of custody, clear suspect-crime link through IP and code match.
strength_assessment.moderate: Prosecutable but vulnerabilities exist: {weaknesses}. Address these before trial.
strength_assessment.weak: Case has critical flaws: {flaws}. High risk of acquittal or mistrial.

score_90_plus.example: Excellent work. All critical evidence present with proper procedures. Clear path to conviction under RA 10175.

score_70_89.example: Good foundation but missing {evidence}. Also, ensure {procedure} is documented for admissibility.

score_50_69.example: Significant issues detected. {violations} make prosecution risky. Must address: {required_actions}

score_below_50.example: Case not prosecutable in current state. Critical failures: {list}. Return to investigation.
